products.name: Cabinet Field Measure Sign-Off
products.product: A focused custom cabinet field measurement approval workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent custom cabinetmakers and small millwork installation teams
products.problem: Plans, site conditions, appliance specifications, walls, utilities, openings, tolerances, customer changes, and production release can diverge after measure.
products.valueProposition: Turns custom cabinet field measurement approval into a visible operating queue so every cabinet job enters production from a reviewed field record and explicit design or customer sign-off.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets custom cabinet field measurement approval software, custom cabinet field measurement approval tracker, custom cabinet field measurement approval template, and custom cabinet field measurement approval checklist searches.
